name: Hamor
bio: Hamor is a Hivite, prince of the city of Shechem, and father of Shechem. After his son violated Dinah, Hamor personally negotiated with Jacob over the marriage, proposing that the two families intermarry, trade freely, and dwell together in the land (Genesis 34:6-10). Hamor agreed to the circumcision condition set by Jacob's sons and persuaded every male in his city to be circumcised to secure the marriage — never anticipating that Simeon and Levi would use the opportunity for revenge, killing him and his son Shechem together (Genesis 34:18-26).
